summary: Backend-only validation of the new 'Catechism in 90 seconds' feature. All 17 backend tests PASS after one structural fix. Verified: GET /api/catechism/today returns full shape (id, ccc_ref, theme, title, quote, expansion, reflection_prompt, date, saved_to_journal, reflection); idempotent for same (user, date); 10 distinct dates produced multiple distinct teachings; Advent (2026-12-01) → theme in season-affinity set (Mary/Hope/Last Things/Prayer/Scripture); Lent (2026-02-25) → Sin/Confession/Suffering/Humility/Virtue/Forgiveness/Prayer/Mercy/Scripture; Easter (2026-04-10) → Christ/Hope/Mary/Forgiveness/Eucharist/Grace/Prayer/Love/Mercy/Scripture. GET /teaching/{id} returns the teaching and 404 for unknown. POST /reflect returns non-empty Claude Sonnet 4.5 reflection (60+ words observed) and 404 for unknown id. POST /save-to-journal writes into db.journal (NOT db.journal_entries) with entry_id starting 'jrn_', kind='catechism', title 'CCC Reflection — …', and full structured payload (teaching_id, ccc_ref, theme, quote, reflection); subsequent GET /today shows saved_to_journal=true; 404 for unknown teaching. GET /api/journal?kind=catechism returns saved entries; ?kind=free excludes catechism. GET /catechism/history returns assignments with total_pool=29. Fixed one structural bug (see action_items): SaveToJournalRequest was originally declared inside build_router(), which caused FastAPI/Pydantic v2 to mis-classify the body parameter as a query field (422 'payload required' on every save). Moved the model to module scope, mirroring ReflectRequest, restoring all save/filter tests.

minor.issue: ORIGINAL BUG (now fixed by tester): SaveToJournalRequest was defined inside build_router() closure. FastAPI's signature resolution under Pydantic v2 / Python 3.11 did NOT recognize a locally-scoped BaseModel as a request-body type, so it treated the `payload` argument as a query parameter, returning HTTP 422 {'type':'missing','loc':['query','payload']} for every well-formed JSON POST. Fix applied: moved the class to module scope at /app/backend/catechism.py:648 (right after ReflectRequest). All 4 previously-failing tests now pass. Main agent should confirm this is the intended structure (consistent with ReflectRequest).

critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/catechism.py — original SaveToJournalRequest was nested inside build_router. FastAPI uses typing.get_type_hints() against the endpoint function, which for closures resolves type names against the function's __globals__, not the local scope. A locally-defined BaseModel therefore fails the isinstance check that distinguishes body vs query parameters, and FastAPI defaults the field to Query. Module-scope declaration (matching ReflectRequest) is the standard pattern; tester applied this fix.

/app/backend/catechism.py:557-626 select_or_assign_teaching — clean, deterministic, race-protected. The 60-day recent-exclusion + season-pool + day-of-year+user-offset modulo is robust. Falls back gracefully if the pool gets exhausted.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the original 422 on /save-to-journal: in /app/backend/catechism.py, the Pydantic model `SaveToJournalRequest` was declared *inside* `build_router(...)` (line 736 of the pre-fix file). FastAPI determines whether a function parameter is a request body or a query parameter by inspecting the annotation via `typing.get_type_hints(endpoint_fn)`. `get_type_hints` resolves forward references against the function's module-level globals — NOT against the enclosing closure's local scope. So when FastAPI introspected `async def save_to_journal(payload: SaveToJournalRequest, ...)` it could not resolve `SaveToJournalRequest` to its actual BaseModel subclass; it fell through to the default classification (Query), producing {'loc':['query','payload'],'msg':'Field required'} on every POST. Reproduction: any well-formed POST to /api/catechism/save-to-journal returned 422 before the fix. Mitigation applied: moved `SaveToJournalRequest` to module scope at /app/backend/catechism.py, immediately after `ReflectRequest` (the existing module-scope model that already worked the same way). After the move and supervisor auto-reload, all 17 tests pass.
